# AnotherSEOGuru App
Source: https://anotherseoguru.com

> AnotherSEOGuru App helps you choose which page to improve using your Google Search Console data. Check the searches behind a change in clicks, ask Aster AI about a page and save a suggested edit as a task. Compare clicks after publishing. Build monthly SEO reports for clients from the same search data, review changes by page and share a PDF. The app also offers keyword research, rank tracking, site audits, content tools and AI visibility checks. Explore the demo with sample data or connect a site with read-only Google access. The web app, mobile apps and integrations use the same account. See each product page for access details. Available in English and Greek from Touristas Technologies.

## Product
- **Home (English)** (<https://anotherseoguru.com/en>) - What AnotherSEOGuru App does, live demo and free sign-up.
- **Αρχική (Ελληνικά)** (<https://anotherseoguru.com/el>) - Το AnotherSEOGuru App στα ελληνικά: λογισμικό SEO από το Search Console.
- **Features** (<https://anotherseoguru.com/en/platform/features>) - The nine modules: opportunities, performance, keywords, content, site audit, competitors, AI visibility, Aster AI assistant, agency tools.
- **Pricing** (<https://anotherseoguru.com/en/pricing>) - Plans Starter $19/mo, Pro $49/mo, Agency $299/mo; two months free on yearly billing. Greek: https://anotherseoguru.com/el/pricing.
- **How it works** (<https://anotherseoguru.com/en/how-it-works>) - Connect Search Console, get ranked fixes, track the result.
- **Security** (<https://anotherseoguru.com/en/platform/security>) - Read-only Google access, data handling and permissions.
- **For agencies** (<https://anotherseoguru.com/en/platform/for/agencies>) - White-label reports, client portal and many sites in one account.
- **White-label SEO reports** (<https://anotherseoguru.com/en/platform/white-label-reports>) - Branded monthly client reports from Google Search Console: PDF, email or scheduled.
- **SEO forecasting tool** (<https://anotherseoguru.com/en/platform/seo-forecasting-tool>) - Extra clicks each fix could earn, from your own Search Console positions and CTR.
- **Εργαλείο αναφορών SEO για πελάτες** (<https://anotherseoguru.com/el/platform/white-label-reports>) - Τι περιλαμβάνουν οι αναφορές πελατών και πότε μπορείτε να προσθέσετε τη δική σας επωνυμία.
- **Δείγμα μηνιαίας αναφοράς SEO** (<https://anotherseoguru.com/el/resources/sample-seo-report>) - Παράδειγμα με ενδεικτικά στοιχεία. Δείτε την αναφορά και αποθηκεύστε τη σε PDF.
- **Sample SEO report** (<https://anotherseoguru.com/en/resources/sample-seo-report>) - A complete monthly client report on sample data, printable as a PDF.
- **For in-house teams** (<https://anotherseoguru.com/en/platform/for/in-house>) - One or a few sites, weekly fixes and reporting.
- **For e-commerce** (<https://anotherseoguru.com/en/platform/for/ecommerce>) - Category and product pages, decaying pages, cannibalization.
- **Integrations (one login)** (<https://anotherseoguru.com/en/platform/integrations>) - One account for the web app, iPhone, Android, Chrome extension, WordPress plugin and AI assistants (MCP).
- **iPhone app** (<https://anotherseoguru.com/en/platform/iphone>) - Native iOS app on the same account: weekly fixes, rank tracking, alerts, AI evidence, widgets.
- **Android app** (<https://anotherseoguru.com/en/platform/android>) - Android app on the same account.
- **SEO Chrome extension** (<https://anotherseoguru.com/en/platform/chrome-extension>) - Free on-page SEO checks (meta, headings, links, images, schema, Open Graph, hreflang, Core Web Vitals) without an account; signed in, the page's own Search Console data.
- **WordPress SEO plugin** (<https://anotherseoguru.com/en/platform/wordpress>) - Free WordPress SEO plugin: Google preview, SEO and readability analysis (Greek-aware), schema, XML sitemaps, redirects, 404 monitor, llms.txt and AI crawler controls; Search Console data and AI titles in the editor; imports from Yoast, Rank Math, AIOSEO, SEOPress.
- **Google Search Console MCP server** (<https://anotherseoguru.com/en/platform/mcp>) - Search Console data, fix list, site audit, live ranks, tasks and AI visibility in Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf and other MCP clients. Remote server https://app.anotherseoguru.com/mcp (OAuth).
- **Compare** (<https://anotherseoguru.com/en/compare>) - AnotherSEOGuru App next to other SEO tools.
- **Free SEO tools** (<https://anotherseoguru.com/en/tools>) - Free single-purpose SEO tools, no account needed.
- **AI visibility check** (<https://anotherseoguru.com/en/ai-visibility-check>) - Free check of how AI assistants describe a brand.
- **Docs** (<https://anotherseoguru.com/en/help>) - How the app works on the web and iPhone (EN + EL). Every docs page has a Markdown twin at its URL + ".md".
- **SEO glossary** (<https://anotherseoguru.com/en/glossary>) - Over 100 SEO, AEO and GEO terms, one page each (EN + EL).
- **Resources** (<https://anotherseoguru.com/en/resources>) - Search Console opportunity finder, AI search page anatomy, search optimization layers.
- **SEO guides** (<https://anotherseoguru.com/en/seo-guides>) - Guides on keywords, on-page, technical SEO, links and local search (EN + EL).
- **Blog** (<https://anotherseoguru.com/en/blog>) - SEO, Search Console and GEO/AEO articles (EN + EL).
- **Sign up** (<https://app.anotherseoguru.com/signup>) - Free sign-up with Google; connects Search Console read-only.

### SEO reporting guides
- [SEO reporting: what to include, how often, and how to make clients read it](https://anotherseoguru.com/en/resources/seo-reporting) - How to build SEO reports clients and managers actually read: the three layers of a report, the metrics that belong in each, cadence, attribution of work to results and what to leave out.
- [SEO report template: a monthly structure with a filled-in example](https://anotherseoguru.com/en/resources/seo-report-template) - A free monthly SEO report template: seven sections in the order clients read them, the question each answers, where the data comes from, and a filled-in example to copy.
- [SEO KPIs: the metrics worth tracking and how to calculate them](https://anotherseoguru.com/en/resources/seo-kpis) - Twelve SEO KPIs in four levels, from business results to technical health, with where each comes from, how to calculate it and the vanity metrics to drop.
- [SEO dashboard: what to show, how to lay it out and where to build it](https://anotherseoguru.com/en/resources/seo-dashboard) - How to build an SEO dashboard people use: what to show for each reader, a widget-by-widget layout, Looker Studio vs a spreadsheet vs an app, and a checklist.
- [SEO reporting tools: how to choose, with a fair look at the main options](https://anotherseoguru.com/en/resources/seo-reporting-tools) - A balanced guide to SEO reporting tools: the criteria that matter, the main options by category, where each fits and how to run a trial before you commit.
- [White-label SEO reports: what to brand, what a client portal adds and a monthly workflow](https://anotherseoguru.com/en/resources/white-label-seo-reports) - White label SEO reports explained for agencies: what to brand, what a client portal adds, a monthly reporting workflow and the pitfalls that cost trust.
- [SEO proposal template: a section-by-section structure, pricing and follow-up](https://anotherseoguru.com/en/resources/seo-proposal-template) - A free SEO proposal template with each section explained, how to price it, how to use the prospect's Search Console data and audit, and how to follow up.

### Οδηγοί για αναφορές SEO
- [Αναφορές SEO: τι να περιλαμβάνουν, πόσο συχνά και πώς να τις διαβάζουν οι πελάτες](https://anotherseoguru.com/el/resources/seo-reporting) - Πώς φτιάχνετε αναφορές SEO που διαβάζουν πελάτες και διοίκηση: τρία επίπεδα, οι δείκτες κάθε επιπέδου, η συχνότητα και η σύνδεση δουλειάς με αποτέλεσμα.
- [Πρότυπο αναφοράς SEO: μηνιαία δομή με συμπληρωμένο παράδειγμα](https://anotherseoguru.com/el/resources/seo-report-template) - Δωρεάν μηνιαίο πρότυπο αναφοράς SEO: επτά ενότητες με τη σειρά που τις διαβάζουν οι πελάτες, η ερώτηση καθεμίας και συμπληρωμένο παράδειγμα.
- [KPI SEO: οι δείκτες που αξίζει να παρακολουθείτε και πώς υπολογίζονται](https://anotherseoguru.com/el/resources/seo-kpis) - Δώδεκα KPI SEO σε τέσσερα επίπεδα, από το αποτέλεσμα της επιχείρησης έως την τεχνική υγεία, με πηγή, υπολογισμό και δείκτες που δεν αξίζει να κρατάτε.
- [Dashboard SEO: τι να δείχνει, πώς να το διατάξετε και πού να το φτιάξετε](https://anotherseoguru.com/el/resources/seo-dashboard) - Πώς φτιάχνετε dashboard SEO που το ανοίγουν: τι δείχνετε σε κάθε αναγνώστη, διάταξη στοιχείο προς στοιχείο και επιλογή Looker Studio, φύλλου ή εφαρμογής.
- [Εργαλεία αναφορών SEO: πώς να διαλέξετε, με δίκαιη ματιά στις βασικές επιλογές](https://anotherseoguru.com/el/resources/seo-reporting-tools) - Πώς διαλέγετε εργαλείο αναφορών SEO: τα κριτήρια που μετράνε, οι βασικές επιλογές ανά κατηγορία, πού ταιριάζει η καθεμία και πώς κάνετε δίκαιη δοκιμή.
- [White-label αναφορές SEO: τι να βάλετε με το όνομά σας, τι προσθέτει η πύλη πελάτη και μια μηνιαία ροή](https://anotherseoguru.com/el/resources/white-label-seo-reports) - White-label αναφορές SEO για εταιρείες: τι μπαίνει με το δικό σας όνομα, τι προσθέτει η πύλη πελάτη, η μηνιαία ροή και τα λάθη που κοστίζουν εμπιστοσύνη.
- [Πρότυπο πρότασης SEO: δομή ενότητα προς ενότητα, αμοιβή και επόμενη επικοινωνία](https://anotherseoguru.com/el/resources/seo-proposal-template) - Δωρεάν πρότυπο πρότασης SEO, με κάθε ενότητα, πώς ορίζετε την αμοιβή, πώς χρησιμοποιείτε το Search Console του υποψήφιου και την επικοινωνία που ακολουθεί.


## Modules
- **Opportunities** (<https://anotherseoguru.com/en/platform/features#opportunities>) - Ranked fixes with an estimated click impact for each.
- **Performance** (<https://anotherseoguru.com/en/platform/features#performance>) - Clicks, impressions, CTR and rankings, with comparisons and annotations.
- **Keywords** (<https://anotherseoguru.com/en/platform/features#keywords>) - Keyword research, rank tracking and topic clusters.
- **Content** (<https://anotherseoguru.com/en/platform/features#content>) - Briefs, AI writing, optimization and WordPress publishing.
- **Site audit** (<https://anotherseoguru.com/en/platform/features#audit>) - Technical health, indexability and Core Web Vitals.
- **Competitors** (<https://anotherseoguru.com/en/platform/features#competitors>) - Competitor discovery, keyword gaps and backlinks.
- **AI visibility** (<https://anotherseoguru.com/en/platform/features#ai-visibility>) - How ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and AI Overviews mention you.
- **Aster AI** (<https://anotherseoguru.com/en/platform/features#assistant>) - Answers grounded in your own Search Console data.
- **Agency workspace** (<https://anotherseoguru.com/en/platform/features#agency>) - Clients, pipeline, tasks and white-label reports.

## Plans (USD)
- **Starter:** $19/month or $190/year (save $38). 2 sites, 1 seat, 500 credits a month. For a business managing its own website.
- **Pro:** $49/month or $490/year (save $98). 5 sites, 2 seats, 2,500 credits a month. For marketers and freelancers publishing or updating content each week.
- **Agency:** $299/month or $2990/year (save $598). 30 sites, 5 seats, 25,000 credits a month. For agencies managing many clients and sites.
- Search Console analysis, opportunities and client reports never use credits. Paid data and some AI tools use credits. Aster AI chat has a daily allowance.
- Full details: <https://anotherseoguru.com/en/pricing> · <https://anotherseoguru.com/el/pricing>

## For AI Agents
- **MCP server**: https://app.anotherseoguru.com/mcp (Streamable HTTP, OAuth 2.1 with PKCE and dynamic client registration). Setup: <https://anotherseoguru.com/en/platform/mcp#clients>. Local-only clients: `npx -y mcp-remote https://app.anotherseoguru.com/mcp`.
- **Agent skills**: `npx skills add otouristas/anotherseoguru-skills` installs SEO workflows (top fixes, weekly report, task fixing, AI visibility) for Claude Code, Codex and other agents that read SKILL.md. Source: <https://github.com/otouristas/anotherseoguru-skills>.
- **Markdown pages**: every page on anotherseoguru.com is also available as Markdown. Append `.md` to the URL (for example <https://anotherseoguru.com/en/platform/mcp.md>, <https://anotherseoguru.com/en.md>) or send the header `Accept: text/markdown`.
- **Safety**: read tools never change anything; task tools only update AnotherSEOGuru App tasks and need the tasks permission.

- [Google Ranking Factors: Confirmed vs Myth](https://anotherseoguru.com/en/blog/google-ranking-factors) - Which Google ranking factors Search Central documents, which popular claims it contradicts, and what to fix instead of a fake checklist.
